theorems.name: Submission.whitney_cover_finite_overlap
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)), IsClosed A → A.Nonempty → ∃ (J : Set (Rn n)) (N : ℕ), J ⊆ Aᶜ ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ s ∈ J, ‖x - s‖ ≤ 5 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)) ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, Set.Finite {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ‖x - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)} ∧ Set.ncard {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ‖x - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20)} ≤ N) ∧ (∀ x ∉ A, Set.Finite {s : Rn n | s ∈ J ∧ ∃ z : Rn n, ‖z - s‖ < 10 * (min 1 (Metric.infDist s A) / 20) ∧ ‖z - x‖ < min 1 (Metric.infDist x A) / 20})
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
